definitions.unit: the arm (one radius, one surface gap); every count is out of the usable seeds in that arm
definitions.gap: SEP - 2R in cells, from the nominal radii
definitions.seed_uids: the two discs are uid 1 and uid 2; with --split-new-uid a lineage is the subtree
definitions.M: mutual coalescence: neither seeded uid has a daughter and both subtrees are gone at the last step
definitions.A: absorption: exactly one seeded subtree is alive at the last step
definitions.P: persistence: both seeded subtrees are alive at the last step
definitions.t_dissolve: the logged step at which neither seeded uid is present any more, minus the first logged step
definitions.no_tolerance: no distance tolerance is used; the reach test of the earlier readout is what amendment 2 removes

controls.refinement: every seed the source series called absorbed must be A here and every both_alive must be P; M is the old 'unresolved' class where the seeds never had daughters
controls.probe: scripts/x142_series.py --probe-control: a fresh repeat of X139's gap-5 arm was identical in series, uid_pairs and summary

fusion.question: does a seed divide because the fusion product is larger?
fusion.verdict: SIZE DOES NOT RULE: 0 of 3 arms have the dividing seeds larger ({'r30_g11': 'divided_is_smaller'}); the sign is inconsistent, so the product's area is not what decides division
